summary: The object the in-mission world tick runs at game+21E0h is the WarningManager, the in-mission warning and radio-chatter director, not an objective or win/lose director. Class name recovered from the literals 'WarningManager Report Error' (009763e0), 'WarningManager unknown message id: %s' (009763e0) and '---WarningManager invalid Message--- %d' (009781e0), all on the same object and all taking its critical section at +24h. Mission completion and failure are not written here; the failure/failureshipyard/failureairfield channels only forward a decision made elsewhere.

walk_rules: Returns at once when the list size at +E8h is zero.

Retire when warning+10h <= now - warning->vtable[7](), with now = 00f876a4. Destroy through vtable[0](1), unlink, _free the node, decrement +E8h and RET. At most one retirement per frame; a candidate held earlier in the walk is discarded unapplied.

Otherwise 005b71d0 decides readiness; a ready warning replaces the held candidate when none is held or when held->vtable[6]() < candidate->vtable[6](). FCOMIP then JBE at 009876c9 means strictly greater priority wins and ties keep the earlier entry.
At the head sentinel, 00974070(candidate) runs when a candidate was held.
